description: Internal transitions written in `Session` change only the states below it: `Review -> .Cart.Reviewing` exits and enters `Cart`, `Home -> .Browsing` exits `Cart` and, taken again in `Browsing`, restarts `Browsing` alone. `Session`'s exit and entry effects do not run, and its invoke and its `after 30m` keep going. The external `Restart -> Session` exits and enters `Session`, cancelling and restarting both; the restarted timer then expires.
